ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, contrasted by a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Visible as a large, contiguous high-intensity white central region spanning the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge (approx. 2-5% width) and covers the distal tips. Small, isolated dark pixel clusters are localized near the trailing margin and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, symmetric V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the full extent of the trailing edge. These manifest as a series of irregular sharp peaks and shallow valleys distinct from the water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, which are sharply pointed and slightly upturned.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, dark, circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scars) are localized on the white ventral surface, primarily concentrated near the black border of the trailing edge and the lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct dark linear pixel disruption is visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the inner field toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark linear mark/scar on the left lobe and irregular jagged serrations along the trailing edge suggestive of minor tissue wear or historical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high degree of depigmentation (predominantly white) with a sharply defined, thin black border along the trailing edge and tips.
